title: The Leakage Advisor's exclusion goes through the person's save path, asks only an installed gateway, and blocks only on evidence
request: The owner asked for a full review of another agent's six commits, with authority to fix bugs.
spec: Fix the reviewer's confirmed findings on 815c0ded with tests.

decisions.decision: The exclusion is proposed by the advisor and saved by the route through _save_solution
decisions.why: one path for every solution change: checks, graph log, audit, ledger, stages cleared

change: dclab_rnd/studio/leakage_advisor.py, dclab_rnd/agentic/routers/projects.py, dclab_rnd/studio/engine.py (project_id, installed_only), dclab_rnd/models/gateway.py and __init__.py (installed_only), tests/test_leakage_advisor.py.

findings.defect: A confirmed exclusion broke every later stage.
findings.scenario: exclude_directly then the features stage: ValidationError forbidden.0.source.
findings.cause: written beside the product's own paths

findings.defect: The exclusion skipped the validator, audit, ledger and stage clearing, and accepted the target or a missing column.
findings.cause: written beside the product's own paths
findings.fix: saved through _save_solution; only columns the advisor reviewed

findings.defect: Harnesses that install no gateway still sent requests through a bare gateway built from .env.
findings.scenario: layer and baseline runs: leakage_review asked outside every cap.
findings.cause: written beside the product's own paths

findings.defect: The request never carried the project id, so the project's cap and consent were skipped.
findings.cause: written beside the product's own paths

findings.defect: A moment word or a name alone was reported as very likely leakage.
findings.scenario: couriers_online blocked for a shared stem with the moment.
findings.cause: written beside the product's own paths
findings.fix: block only on the audit's own verdict or an extreme heuristic; the rest asked

findings.defect: The notes_off regression test never ran.
findings.cause: written beside the product's own paths

outcome: Fixed six of eight; the lost update during compare_both is avoided by saving a fresh project, and staleness by problem revision is not wired (open).
lessons: Run a stage after every change a feature makes to the solution.
A test placed after the main block never runs: count the tests that ran.
risks: Staleness by problem revision is still not wired.
